title: TAMIU takes over the Kazen Center: 'TAMIU Day at LC' helps Laredo College students plan their transfer
excerpt: Texas A&M International University hosts TAMIU Day at Laredo College today, Wednesday, Oct. 21, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. outside the Kazen Center — an open house where LC students get one-on-one help with admissions, financial aid and degree pathways during National Transfer Week.
content:
Texas A&M International University (TAMIU) is bringing the university to Laredo College students today. TAMIU Day at Laredo College runs Wednesday, Oct. 21, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. outside the Kazen Center at LC's Fort McIntosh campus, giving Palominos a chance to explore transfer options and map out their next step toward a bachelor's degree, according to TAMIU.

The open house puts LC students face to face with representatives from across the university — admissions, financial aid, housing, the testing center and student engagement offices — for information and personalized guidance on the transfer process. Academic representatives from TAMIU's four colleges will also be on hand to talk degree programs, academic opportunities and transfer pathways.

"We want to ensure a smooth transition for our transfer students by offering the support necessary for success," said Mirian Granados, director of TAMIU's Office of Recruitment and School Relations, who said the event is built to connect prospective transfer students directly with the staff who can help them make the move.

The visit lands in the middle of National Transfer Week, Oct. 19–23, when TAMIU celebrates the students who transfer in and the professionals who support their journeys. And for LC students who can't make today's session, the door stays open year-round: TAMIU keeps an on-campus transfer office at LC's Fort McIntosh campus, in room 240 of the Lerma Peña Building, where staff answer questions and offer one-on-one guidance.

For more information about TAMIU Day at LC, contact the TAMIU Office of Recruitment and School Relations at enroll@tamiu.edu or 956.326.2270.

Sources: Texas A&M International University (tamiu.edu), "TAMIU at LC Day Scheduled for Wednesday, Oct. 21" (Oct. 8, 2026); TAMIU NewsHub, National Transfer Week (Oct. 15, 2026).

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
